preconditions.description: Attacker must have some WBTC tokens to open a position
Contract must not be paused (paused == false)

exploit_hint: The vulnerability allows users to pass arbitrary prices when opening and closing positions. To exploit: 1) Open a position with a manipulated low price to acquire more tokens than deserved. 2) Close the position with a manipulated high price to extract excess value. The exact functions aren't shown in the provided code, but look for functions like openPosition(price) or closePosition(price) that accept price parameters without validation.
